notes: INSIDE half of the Siren Ion (neon): a big faceted crystal capacitor that brightens as it charges (dull, blue edges, cyan, then white-cyan with a magenta core at ready), power coupling, hatch, cyan/magenta strip. fire: the crystal flashes white. damaged: crystal cracked, lamps dead; disabled: crystal dark and split. Barrel layer siren_ion_neon_barrel: a horn-shaped emitter with crystal fins and a sensor pod; fire: sound-wave arcs in magenta and cyan roll out of the mouth. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
